description: We are interested in space exploration and learning about the history of abandoned space missions. Our goal is to create an informative and creative project about old space equipment on the Moon and Mars. We enjoy researching, storytelling and sharing knowledge about space.
summary: Our project is about the old machines and equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. We want to explore why NASA sent these machines, what they did, and what happened to them after their missions ended. Through this project, we hope to share interesting facts about space exploration in a simple way so that students and others can learn more about space.
details:
Lost Machines of Space is an educational project about the machines left behind on the Moon and Mars after completing their missions.

Our website explains the history and importance of these machines, including the Apollo Lunar Module descent stages, Lunar Roving Vehicles, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, and InSight.

The main purpose of this project is to help people understand that these machines are not just abandoned objects. They are important parts of space exploration history and helped scientists learn more about the Moon and Mars.

The project provides simple information about these machines, their missions, and their scientific contributions. It also encourages people to learn more about space exploration and future missions.

We created this project using Google Sites for the website, Gamma AI for the presentation, and ChatGPT for help with research organization and writing. We did not use special hardware or programming languages.

The creative idea behind this project is to tell the story of forgotten space machines and show why their contributions should not be forgotten.

Our project aims to increase awareness about space exploration, science, and the importance of past missions.
